response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive senior-level software development experience with a strong focus on open-source technologies, full-stack development, and technical leadership. While his background aligns well with many requirements, his German language proficiency and explicit experience in IT architecture/technical project management are less evident, warranting further exploration in an interview.
strengths: Proven track record in senior software development roles with exposure to diverse tech stacks (e.g., TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Kubernetes).
Strong open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective) and advocacy for modern development practices (TDD, CI/CD, mentorship).
Demonstrated ability to design and architect systems (e.g., real-time data platforms, geo-data applications) and lead interdisciplinary projects.
concerns: German language proficiency is listed as 'Basic,' below the required C1 level for the role.
Limited explicit evidence of high-level IT architecture or technical project management experience (e.g., no mention of UML or complex system design).
No clear examples of strategic client advisory or executive-level collaboration in the resume.
